The fighting prowess of Cathay's greatest can be taken in draught form when a further burst of aggression is needed to tip the balance in the Celestial Emperor's favour.
This concoction enables the taker to not just wound their opponent, but set deadly poison in the lacerated flesh as well.

wh2_dlc11_character_abilities_all_hands_.loc_tooltip: Everyone on deck! We 'ave them now!

wh_pro04_unit_abilities_apocalyptic_char.loc_tooltip: If you see him coming run as fast as you can… not that it will do you any good whatsoever!

wh2_main_character_abilities_assassins_t.loc_tooltip: It should be no great surprise that those already adept in the art of silent death continue to improve with time and practice.

wh2_dlc11_character_abilities_avast_ye.loc_tooltip: Now listen up and listen good, yer salty sea-dogs…
